snippet.title: Chris's Classroom V1.8 - Pause Menu, Credits, and Beans!
snippet.description:
This new update of Chris's Classroom brings several neat features!

↓↓↓ Update V1.8 Log ↓↓↓
- Added custom 3D modeled chairs
- Added pause menu
- Added Credits
- Added Gooby Bean[1]
- Added Aubey Bean (WIP)
- Changed bad ending scene slightly

[1] Gooby Bean will bounce around the map. He's only really a threat when he comes into contact with the player, to which he will flashbang the player and limit their vision temporarily.

Engine used: Unity 2022.3.62f1
Almost all assets shown in game are created by me!
